Further reading and useful links

Healthy Multiplicity

Healthy Multiplicity has been a core, essential resource for selves-help and selves discovery, and an immensely helpful resource base.

Visit Healthy Multiplicity

LB’s Non-fiction Index

While LB Lee also writes about non-plural stuff, the Non-fiction Index contains a fair bit of essays and useful resources, including a crisis-handling and crisis planning guide.

LB’s Non-fiction Index

Quick’N’Dirty Plural History

LB’s four-part series about plurality and its history — “covering actions, interpretations, labels, and slapfights” of various plural camps from 1811 to 2019.

Quick’N’Dirty Plural History

Video essay on YouTube

The Layman’s Guide to Plurality

By Four and Twenty, this guide from the early 2000s answers some questions about multiplicity and is a snapshot of plural history from that era.

The Layman’s Guide to Plurality

LB’s bibliography dump

LB has a many-selved book scans and PDF hoard, and most of them are digital! If you want to take a look at historical mentions of plurality, this is where to start.

LB’s Book Scans
